'''Droideka Beta''' was one of the few [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] to survive the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the mass deactivation in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Around [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] it joined the [[IG-88's Droid Army]] and became a part of the [[Droid Revolution]] led by the rogue [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]], participating in the [[Mechis III Uprising]].<ref name ="COTF" />
